name: drydock
description: Keeps an AI agent inside the files you said it may touch: a hook denies writes outside a declared scope, Bash writes are detected, and an audit checks the diff. Use it alone, beside any planner, as a PR check, or with plan-first parallel waves. Nothing sails until it leaves the dock.

plans_dir.title: Plans directory
plans_dir.description: Repo-relative directory where plan documents are written and read

docs_targets.title: Closing doc targets
docs_targets.description: Comma-separated repo-relative paths the closing wavecheck may propose updates for (never auto-edited)

e2e_dir.title: Generated E2E spec directory
e2e_dir.description: Repo-relative directory the Testing Gate Playwright specs are written into

config_path.title: Host profile path
config_path.description: Repo-relative path to the drydock.config.yaml host profile written by planwright on its first run
